title: Readiness funnels and genuine urgency only
origin: ClimbOS synthesis (original proposal) from the member frameworks; author guidance is cited by finding id, proposed rules are labelled 'proposed'.
decision_task: How to move not-yet-ready buyers toward purchase, and which offer, range or urgency levers are allowed.
applies_when: Buyers need time or education before buying
exclusions: Impulse purchases where buyers are ready at once
required_inputs: Owner-confirmed facts for any deadline, capacity or price claim
evidence_requirements: Share of visitors not ready (exit survey 'just looking' / 'need to think', or sales notes)
Whether the final conversion page is under the business's control
Most-liked products (survey), not just best sellers
Prior selling prices with dates if any reference price is shown
missing_data_behavior: No confirmed fact: no urgency or scarcity claim.

decision_branches.then: State it with the confirmed fact.

decision_branches.if: Sale completes on a partner site

implementation_steps: Design each step with a clear reward
Define the true goal metric across the handover
Confirm the offer problem from diagnosis
Compute margin and break-even in code
dependencies: Consent for any contact capture and follow-up; Resend only for consented lifecycle mail
Ad budget and consent before retargeting
Tracking access on the final conversion page or a partner report
Owner approval of any price change
Jurisdiction rules for reference prices, urgency and price testing

cash_and_labor_requirements.cash: $0 for owned steps; ad spend only if approved
cash_and_labor_requirements.labor: 4-12 hours to build an intermediate step
cash_and_labor_requirements.measurement: Step conversions and partner-reported final conversions

guardrails: No rolling deadlines, fake countdowns or 'was' prices (book endorses them; ClimbOS policy wins).
alternatives_when_constrained: No email consent: content the visitor can return to; owner social follow
No partner tracking: periodic partner reports, labelled
No traffic for price tests: interviews with willingness-to-pay questions labelled stated, or a pilot with new customers only
No intention data: site-search logs and competitor offering scan
stop_conditions: Opt-ins rise but buyers do not within the window: revisit the step
Partner conversion data unavailable after negotiation: label click-outs as proxy
review_triggers: Owner's numbers or business type change
A dated benchmark this playbook mentions is superseded
Lead capture inflates leads but not sales
Pressure notifications erode trust and may breach consumer rules
Free can backfire as 'too good to be true'
Cheapest position is open to one competitor only

contextual_heuristic.rule: proposed: when the final conversion is off-site, the plan's primary metric is the partner-confirmed conversion; click-outs are labelled proxy

external_requirement.rule: proposed: urgency and scarcity claims need an owner-confirmed deadline or stock fact before they appear in copy
proposed: a reference ('was') price requires an owner-confirmed prior selling price and period; otherwise block it

missing_prerequisite.rule: proposed: contact capture and retargeting require consent and, for retargeting, an approved ad budget

strategic_preference.rule: proposed: offer changes are proposed only when diagnosis names an offer problem; otherwise route to clarity, trust or readiness
proposed: gap-analysis revenue estimates are labelled assumptions and computed in code

reconciliation_note: Backlog CG-07 makes this a deterministic lint.
